newsitem.title: USA: Nortel, Williams Communications in pact.
newsitem.headline: Nortel, Williams Communications in pact.

text.p: Williams Communications Group Inc, a unit of Williams Cos, and Nortel (Northern Telecom) said they had agreed to combine their customer premise equipment sales and service operations.
The combination would create a new company called WilTel Communications LLC which would provide total enterprise network solutions for business customers across North America.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed and the deal was set to close within 30 to 45 days, they said.

Williams Communications Group would be the majority owner of the new company, which combined Nortel's corporate-owned private branch exchange and key systems-related equipment distribution business with WilTel, Williams Communications' existing enterprise network solutions subsidiary, they said.
Nortel would own a minority interest in the new company, not to exceed 30 percent, it said.
Prior to the close of the deal, Nortel would acquire a minority interest Bell Atlantic Corp held in Bell Atlantic Meridian Systems, which would be contributed to WilTel Communications LLC, they said.
The agreement also included Nortel's TTS Meridian Systems Inc business, which provided customer premise equipment and service throughout Canada.

Under the agreement, WilTel Communications would sell and support a portfolio of equipment from a variety of manufacturers in order to provide its customers a full array of enterprise network solutions.
